units.leftText: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
units.rightText: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:

units.leftText: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
units.rightText: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.

units.leftText: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
units.rightText: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.

units.leftText: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
units.rightText: And now I urge you, dear lady — not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning — that we love one another.

units.leftText: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
units.rightText: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.

units.leftText: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
units.rightText: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

units.leftText: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
units.rightText: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.

units.leftText: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
units.rightText: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.

units.leftText: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
units.rightText: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.

units.leftText: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
units.rightText: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.

units.leftText: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
units.rightText: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

units.leftText: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
units.rightText: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
